text: {"lessons":["I repeatedly sold positions after gains, which felt satisfying, but a gain alone is not a reason to sell; I should judge each holding by its prospects and role in the portfolio.","My purchase price is not a reason to keep a losing position or sell a winning one. I should avoid treating each stock as a separate account and consider the whole portfolio.","Past price changes do not predict future returns. I should make deliberate decisions based on risk and diversification, rather than trading for the emotional relief of locking in gains."]}
